'''Steak tartare''' is a meat dish made from finely chopped, or ground raw [[Cookbook:Beef|beef]]. It is often served with [[Cookbook:Onion|onions]] and seasonings, and sometimes with raw [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]]. This dish is popular in Belgium, where it is known as ''filet américain'' ("American fillet").

== Ingredients == 
* ½ [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] (227 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) of quality tender [[Cookbook:Beef|beef]] (filet mignon) with all connective tissue removed
* 1 [[Cookbook:Egg Yolk|egg yolk]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Worcestershire Sauce|Worcestershire]] or [[Cookbook:Soy sauce|soy]] sauce 
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] whole grain [[Cookbook:Mustard|mustard]] 
* 1–3 drops [[Cookbook:Hot Sauce|hot pepper sauce]], as desired 
* 2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Onion|onions]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* Freshly ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]] to taste
* Sliced bread (e.g. [[Cookbook:Rye|rye]], [[Cookbook:Pumpernickel|pumpernickel]], etc.)

== Procedure ==
# Finely chop the beef, or run it twice through a meat grinder with a ¼ [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (0.64 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]]) plate.
# Loosely combine the minced beef, egg yolk, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, hot sauce, onions, salt, and pepper.
# Spread on the bread slices to make open-faced [[Cookbook:Sandwiches|sandwiches]]. The steak tartare may also be served on buttered [[Cookbook:Toast|toast]].
# Serve on chilled plates with a favorite beverage.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Note that consumption of steak tartare made with contaminated ingredients can cause serious illness or death. It is very likely that one can contract either pathogenic E. coli infection or salmonellosis since even the best ground beef is a composite of many different slaughtered animals, increasing the risk incrementally.
* In Poland, steak tartare is called ''tatar'' or ''stek jednojajeczny'', and diced Polish style pickled cucumber or polish Gherkin "ogorek konserwowy" is sometimes added.
